info.name: Legal Practice Management API - With Authentication
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for testing the Legal Practice Management Django REST API with JWT authentication and role-based authorization.

## Authentication System
This API uses JWT (JSON Web Token) authentication with role-based permissions:
- **Admin Lawyers**: Full access to all data and operations
- **Regular Lawyers**: Limited access to assigned mandates and own time entries

## Getting Started
1. Import this collection and environment into Postman
2. Start Django server: `python manage.py runserver`
3. Create demo users: `python manage.py create_demo_users --clear`
4. Use the Authentication folder to login and get tokens
5. Test different access levels with admin vs regular user tokens

## Demo Users
- **Admin**: sarah.wilson@lawfirm.com / admin123
- **Regular**: michael.chen@lawfirm.com / lawyer123
- **Junior**: emma.rodriguez@lawfirm.com / lawyer123
